programme.desc: The body of a visitor is found on-site at the famous relish factory of Plummer & Son in the village of Little Upton. It is not long before legal documents, family resentments and mysterious sightings add to the complexity of the case.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Retired music teacher Arthur Leggott is murdered after disturbing an intruder at his home in Badger's Drift. When the manuscript shows signs that it has been written by another hand, a handwritten letter by Joan Alder turns up indicating the manuscript is a forgery. Where the manuscript goes more murders follow.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Alice Bly arrives at Lawnside, a nursing home in Aspern Tallow to rest after having hospital treatment. Alice's nephew DCI Barnaby agrees to look into things despite having a week's leave. It is not long before two more deaths quickly follow the first and a mysterious visitor is seen lurking around at night.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The residents of Midsomer Mallow are preparing for the 'Perfect English Village' competition even though a few days earlier saw the murder of local thief and lothario, Peter Drinkwater (Orlando Bloom). The detectives must deduce if one of his burglary victims, his accomplice in the robberies or another disgruntled villager may have been the killer.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A veterinarian (Jessica Tuck) in a small farming community becomes alarmed when a genetically-engineered corn seed, intended to produce faster, larger yields of corn, produces something far more alarming …human mutations! Len Cariou also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After losing his wife and son in a horrific car accident some twenty years earlier, a scientist (Joel Gray) uses advanced technology to build the perfect robotic version of his son. But perfection is not always so perfect...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Due to dwindling resources in the future, the world consists of "Alphas" and "Betas" who are alternately put in stasis for 72 hour periods, all in service to the "Elites," who lord over the Alphas and the Betas...But a resistance is coming.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a man arrives at al UFO convention with part of an alien ship, it throws the annual gathering of "true believers" into chaos and leads to a conspiracy, a cover-upï¿½and murder. But who is conspiring with whom? And what are they covering up?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After being brought back from death, a woman (Laura Leighton) discovers she was one part of a pair of conjoined twins, the other lost during pregnancy. And now that twin, living dormant in her body for all these years, wants a life of her own.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Tom (Tate Donovan) and Wendy (Gabrielle Miller) are the perfect couple, happy and very much in love. But at night, Tom has terrible memory flashes about being stuck in a burning building The nightmares, however, aren't real…and neither is Tom.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After the plane he is traveling in is struck by lightning, a Presidential candidate is visited by a time traveler who tells him that he needs to escape impending death because his presidency is the key to preventing an apocalyptic future.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The crew of a space salvage ship is awakened from hyper-sleep when they come across a mysterious object floating through space. They soon discover the pod contains a tyrant, in stasis, who was banished from Earth for crimes against humanity.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Time-traveler Dr. Theresa Givens (Amanda Plummer) faces the death penalty for using her time machine in a future where all technology is banned due to a devastating nuclear holocaust some 20 years earlier. Charlton Heston also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A couple and their friend join a mysterious religious sect in order to lead a more spiritual existence and find a new direction in life. They soon learn, however, that their new-found direction may take them further than they ever thought possible.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Mona Lisa, an android who was created to spy and kill, is designed with superior intelligence. But it is that superior intellect which allows her to evolve, leading her to question the morality of her prime directive...and her own existence.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil shares advice for dealing with rude, crude and obnoxious behavior from your family members.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Moms are accused of bullying their own children.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nicky, 17, says she loves to fight and proudly posts the videos of the brawls on the Internet. The teen brags that she once cracked a girl’s head on the concrete, has broken cheekbones and noses, and has had so many confrontations, she's lost count. She says the police have been called to her home as many as 80 times, and she’s been arrested monthly since she was 13 years old. What’s at the root of her rage? Dr. Phil delves deep into Nicky’s past to find the source of her pain. And, Nicky’s mom, Yvette, says she feels helpless and fears her daughter will end up dead or in prison, but is she modeling bad behavior? An anonymous letter to the show makes shocking allegations against Yvette. Can Dr. Phil get this family help -- before someone gets really hurt -- or worse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil follows up with Charles and Tracy. After coming to the conclusion that his dream of being shared by his wife and mistress was never going to happen, did Charles follow through and end his relationship with the other woman?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A former FLDS spokesperson, Willie Jessop, comes face to face with critics.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil explores a disturbing trend: Female teachers engaging in sex acts with their underage male students. The number of accusations has doubled in the past five years. You've probably heard of famous cases like Mary Kay Letourneau, Debra Lafave and the recent case of a teacher in Southern California, Meredith Johnson Vincent, who was arrested on suspicion of having a sexual relationship with a 14-year-old boy. Dr. Phil meets one teacher who has chosen to fight back.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: How to Fix a Broken Family
programme.desc: You've heard people complain, "If I only knew then what I know now, I wouldn't be in this mess," but what about those times when you choose not to see the writing on the wall? Dr. Phil meets couples who say their relationships went from bad to worse after they said, "I do," and now their families are broken.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nikki says her three-year marriage has turned volatile. She claims her husband, Mark, has punched her in the face, broken her nose and run over her toe with his truck -- among other allegations -- which he denies. Mark claims Nikki instigates most of their fights and has violent outbursts, and he suspects she might be trying to kill him. The couple admits their confrontations happen in front of their two young children, and both say they want to save their marriage. Dr. Phil intervenes for the sake of their kids. Can this toxic relationship be healed?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The children of Drew Peterson deal with the reality of their father's suspected involvement in their mother's murder and stepmother's disappearance.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation continues with Heather, who says she is not at fault for her son's accidental overdose. But- where was she that night?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Some believe self-censorship is a big problem today, particularly in light of the idea that someone can be "canceled" for their words -- blocked from having a prominent public platform or career for sharing their opinion. Dr. Phil interviews Nate, a former Idaho police officer, who claims he was fired after making a TikTok video about NBA superstar LeBron James that went viral and has been viewed over 4 million times. Nate explains how the fall-out from the video affected him and his family, too. Dr. Phil also speaks with conservative political commentator Tomi Lahren, who says she recently had to be protected by state police from student protestors at the University of New Mexico. Greg Lukianoff, president of the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression, says he believes Americans have lost the ability to discuss their differences rationally. And, Dr. Shaun Harper, founder and Executive Director of the USC Race and Equity Center, says he is firmly against hate speech and feels people need to be more mindful about the effects of their words.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman who shot her fiancé in the leg after he cheated wants to marry him.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Horrific allegations are tearing a family apart — but who is telling the truth? Todd says he was shocked and appalled when his ex-girlfriend's mother, Diana, accused him of molesting his 4-year-old daughter, Taniya, and turns to Dr. Phil to help clear his name. Diana says that while babysitting Taniya, the toddler detailed ways in which Todd inappropriately touched her, and she's convinced he's done the unthinkable. After learning of the accusations, Taniya's mom, Latia, reported the alleged sexual abuse to a judge who immediately stripped Todd of his parental rights — but was justice served? Latia says that as much as she wants to believe Todd's innocence, as a mother, she needs to take every precaution to protect her child. A year has passed since he's seen his daughter, and Todd says he will go to any length to prove his innocence, including taking another a lie detector test — even though he's already passed one. He's adamant that Diana is lying and says that she coached Taniya to make the accusations. Dr. Phil calls in an expert polygraph examiner. Don't miss the shocking results!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Christina, who emailed him desperate for help for her daughter, Tara, who she says can be an angry monster. Christina left the home when Tara was 13 years old, but now, she says she's worried that her daughter is in a toxic situation with the ex-husband she calls narcissistic and his 22-year-old new wife who is 20 weeks pregnant. Today, meet the new wife and find out if Dr. Phil can help this chaotic triangle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Gypsy Willis- the former mistress of a doctor convicted of murdering his wife- speaks out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A husband cheated on his wife with her sister.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Is Mom Leading a Secret Life?
programme.desc: Brandy, 24, and Jacki, 27, say they believe their mother, Kimberly, is leading an X-rated secret sex life, while maintaining the façade of a happy marriage of 29 years to their stepfather. Kimberly says her daughters are stirring up drama with half-truths and misinformation and need to butt out of her business. Can Dr. Phil get to the truth — and help put this family back together?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Laurie-Ann emailed Dr. Phil claiming she was robbed by her dangerous, narcissist ex-boyfriend and his new fiancée, Alison. She claims her ex, Michael, held her hostage for seven years. Laurie-Ann claims Michael and Alison are retaliating against her for breaking her silence and filing charges against Michael for domestic violence, emotional abuse, theft, and fraud. But Michael and Alison say Laurie-Ann is a liar who is always playing the victim. Michael says he never held her hostage; she only started to say that because he dumped her. Alison says she just wants Laurie-Ann to move on with her life, let them be happy, and stop stalking them. But Laurie-Ann says Alison doesn’t know how vindictive Michael really is and she claims he has turned everyone, including the police, against her. Laurie-Ann says she wants Dr. Phil to validate her story.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Alan’s social media pictures have been used for nine years as catfish bait to lure women into online relationships. The catfish has been caught and “he” is really a “she” – 24-year-old Sarah. Sarah’s boyfriend, “Ken,” says he had no idea she was conning so many women for so many years. Sarah meets her bait, and Dr. Phil uncovers why Sarah says she has been pretending to be a man online for so long. Amanda and Alan claim Sarah is addicted to catfishing and really good at lying, and say they don’t believe she will ever stop. Can Sarah stop the con?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil explores the controversial trend of older women dating much younger men. Is age really just a number? First, Pie, a 58-year-old self-admitted cougar, has been dating 24-year-old Oleg for four months -- and her best friend, Terese, strongly disapproves. Could Pie be headed for heartbreak? Then, 52-year-old divorcée Bella says her relationship with 32-year-old Eddie is the best she has ever had. Eddie says he loves Bella and doesn’t mind that she’s the same age as his mother. Does this couple see a long-term future together? And, 76-year-old Aalsa -- former Miss Cougar America -- says after 40, men go downhill! After dating younger men for four decades, what advice does she have for fellow cougars? Tune in and decide for yourself: Can a relationship really survive a significant age gap?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Rules, stipulations, conditions and ultimatums -- not exactly romantic pillow talk, but when it comes to marriage, what qualifies as a deal-breaker? Shane and Nikki got married four months ago. Nikki says that three days into their honeymoon, Shane told her that he wasn't sure he loved her enough to be married. He said he would give the marriage a six- to 12-month trial, and if it doesn't work, he's out. Nikki says there is no way she will stay in a trial marriage. Why did Shane marry Nikki in the first place? And, should Nikki wait for him to make a decision, or should she cut her losses and get out now? Then, Daniel and Debra are engaged and planning to get married in October, but Daniel says he's ready to call off the wedding if Debra doesn't stop asking him, "Do I look fat?" A recovering bulimic now weighing 100 pounds, Debra says she wants Daniel to support her recovery, and he is wrong to postpone the wedding. When Dr. Phil shows them a video of a previous anorexic guest, will Daniel and Debra change their outlook? Is there hope that this couple will make it down the aisle?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Friend is Obsessed with Me
programme.desc: Traci says her former friend, Jinda, is obsessed and infatuated with her. Traci says Jinda began texting her about 50 times a day after they first met -- texts that soon became over-the-top proclamations such as, “I can’t get you out of my mind," and “I swear I will love you the right way.” Traci says she thought Jinda just needed a friend but then grew more uncomfortable as, she claims, Jinda was also inappropriately affectionate with her children, began texting her friends whom she had never met, and even tried to touch and kiss her. Traci claims Jinda crossed the line when she tried to sabotage her marriage, so she cut off communication with her. But is Jinda getting the message? Traci says Jinda still texts and drives by her house, and she worries what Jinda might do next. Jinda admits to being "needy and clingy" but does she see that she's overstepped her boundaries? Can Dr. Phil help her rein in her behavior? Then, Kari says her sister, Holly, stabbed her in the back when she took Kari’s ex-husband’s side during their divorce -- and, after not speaking for three years, she wants an apology. Holly says she’s not sorry and that Kari is the one who needs to apologize. Can Dr. Phil end the silence between these sisters?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Should transgender athletes be allowed to compete with those of the gender they identify with or must they only compete with athletes who share the gender they were assigned at birth? Are laws that ban transgender women from participating in women's sports fair? LGBTQ+ activists have described criteria limiting transgender athlete involvement in gendered sports as "discriminatory.” Lia Thomas made headline news and stirred debate when she competed in swimming nationals as a transgender woman. Dr. Phil, along with Layne Ingram, a transgender man and basketball coach, and Olympic swimmer Nancy Hogshead-Makar, an advocate for girls and women in sports and CEO of Champion Women, discuss what they believe is right and fair. Then, Riley Gaines, who competed against Lia Thomas, gives her perspective on how she felt after their race. The big question is: what does the science say? Harvard professor Dr. Carole Hooven breaks it down.

The famous exotic dancer has come to represent beauty and the power of feminine seduction. The documentary Mata Hari - the Beautiful Spy tracks down the true story of this fascinating woman.

programme.title: Osama Bin Laden - Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: Just after midnight on May 2, 2011, United States Special Forces raided the compound in Abbottabad, Pakistan, where Osama Bin laden had been hiding for years. “America’s public enemy number one” was killed during the operation. The Navy SEALs thoroughly searched his house, recovering everything that could provide information about Bin Laden and his terrorist network Al-Qaeda: His documents and private correspondence, as well as every electronic data carrier.

programme.title: The Child Crusades - Barefoot to the Promised Land
programme.desc: In Cologne in 1212 a boy named Nicholas captivated thousands of children between the ages of eight and fifteen with his fanatical speeches. They had been chosen, he said, to liberate Jerusalem. Likewise, in the French town of Cloyes a young shepherd gathered numerous children around him with the same proclamation.

programme.title: The Biblical Plagues

programme.title: The Biblical Plagues
programme.desc: For a long time, scientists have tried to prove that nine of the Ten Plagues described in the Old Testament point to a serious breakdown of the climate, triggering an ecological chain reaction. Apart from theological considerations, scholars all over the world have studied individual phenomena, trying to explain the causes of this Biblical disaster.

programme.title: The Biblical Plagues
programme.desc: Although nine disastrous plagues had already devastated the land along the Nile, Pharaoh remained stubborn and would not release Moses and his people from slavery. And so their God, Yahweh, planned his final assault: At midnight, he sent death over Egypt – all the firstborn, Man or beats, had to die … there was no escape.

programme.title: Monsters and Myths
programme.desc: Monsters have always been part of our nightmares and fairy tales. But where do they actually come from? How much of them is truth, how much is myth? Going to great lengths in this documentary, the filmmakers join scientists to explore a number of the best known sagas and legends in the world.

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “... all the waters that were in the river [Nile] were turned to blood. And all the fish that was in the river died,” reports the Bible, “and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river.” (Exodus 7:20–21).

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “… so there were lice upon man, and upon beast,” reports the Bible, “all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.” (Exodus 8:18, 17). Even today, two million people die every year from malaria transmitted by mosquitoes, mainly in Africa.

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “… and the Lord sent thunder and hail, … and fire mingled with the hail,” reports the Old Testament. “And the hail smote … all that was in the field, both man and beast.” (Exodus 9:23–25).

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “... locusts … invaded all Egypt …. They covered all the ground until it was black,” reports the Bible. “They devoured … everything growing in the fields … – nothing green remained on trees or palms in all the lands of Egypt.” (Exodus 10:14–15). Swarms of locusts are still a very real plague today.

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “… darkness that can be felt … covered all Egypt for three days,” reports the Bible. “No one could see anyone else … for three days.” (Exodus 10:22–23). Dust storms frequently paralyze public life during the storm season in many of the most arid regions of the Earth, burying roads and human settlements, threatening the lives of humans and animals alike.

programme.title: Children of the Wild
programme.desc: In many cultures there are myths about “wolf children” who were taken from their families and then grew up in the wild, either alone or with wolves, bears or other animals. But how close are such stories to reality? This program offers a combination of two stories: the true story of the monkey boy John Ssebunya in Uganda, and that of Rudyard Kipling’s Mowgli, the most famous, albeit fictitious, wolf child of all. Unlike the children in the myths and stories, children who grow up without human beings have massive problems integrating themselves into society. The program specifically follows the fate of the young Ugandan boy John Ssebunya. If there is no human being as communication partner in the first years of a child’s life, the wolf child will yelp, growl, scream or grunt. He is not yet ready to make contact with other children.

programme.title: In Search of Santa Claus
programme.desc: The amazing transformation of a holy man from Turkey into the world-wide symbol of Christmas cheer. He's one of the most widely recognized figures in the world; but what are the origins of St. Nicholas, and how did he become Santa Claus? With criminological acumen, this one-hour documentary sorts the myths from the facts to present the true story of the first multi-national saint, revered by the Catholic, Protestant and Orthodox churches alike.

programme.title: The Secret of the Phaistos Code
programme.desc: Is the Phaistos Disc a clever fake? The film follows the trail of possibly one of the greatest archaeological scandals ever. The search for the truth starts in the ancient Cretan palace complexes of Phaistos. The North American art dealer Jerome Eisenberg, one of the world’s foremost forgery experts, considers the “Phaistos Disc” to be a latter-day fake. In 1908, it was discovered by the Italian archaeologist Luigi Pernier. Since then, the disc has aroused the scientific ambition of countless linguists. The British academic Gareth Owens has analyzed new archaeological discoveries with unfamiliar characters and believes the disc to be genuine. But Eisenberg remains convinced that the disc cannot be deciphered at all. He claims that not only does it not reveal a text that has ever been decipherable, but also that is not even of ancient origin.

programme.title: The Advance of the Hanseatic League
programme.desc: At the bottom of the Baltic Sea lies a cog, a relic of the might of the German Hanse, a league of merchantmen founded about 1200 AD. Archaeologists are retracing its final voyage using state of the art technology as well as ancient scripts. Their search takes them to the Norwegian port of Bergen, to the Shetlands and even as far as Iceland.

programme.title: Expedition in the South Seas
programme.desc: He is one of the greatest German explorers of all time even though his name fell into oblivion: As luck would have it, in 1772 17-year-old Georg Forster was given the chance to accompany the greatest navigator of his time, James Cook, on his world circumnavigation. On this voyage, Captain Cook discovered islands and peoples, while Georg Forster focused on animals and plants, discovering more than 400 species that had been unknown to Europeans until then. “Terra X” follows German actor Robert Atzorn on his search for traces around the world. He gets to know a young man, whose philosophy and conception of the world still appear to be really modern. Sophisticated dramatic reconstructions bring the fateful sea journey to life. The film portrays a great natural scientist whose knowledge and legacy determined patterns for scientific research in the 21st century.

programme.title: The Deadly Treasure of Lake Kivu
programme.desc: In Lake Kivu, on the borders of Rwanda and Congo, there is methane gas worth $25 billion. Enough to supply central Africa’s energy needs for generations. But if it explodes, it will kill up to two and a half million people living on Lake Kivu’s shores. The danger is real.

programme.title: In Search of the Golden Fleece
programme.desc: When Jason and his crew of 50 men set sail, a dangerous journey to what was then known as the end of the world lies ahead of the Greek heroes. The young hero had a one-of-a-kind galley built for the voyage, which he baptized "Argo." The mighty rowing boat was designed to take the committed band to the legendary land of Colchis, beyond the Dardanelles.

programme.title: Wandering Wolves
programme.desc: For most Europeans, the wolf is more of a myth than an actual wild animal. But since the nineties, Isengrim has been making his way back to the middle of the continent, kilometre by painstaking kilometre. Part One of ‘Wandering Wolves’ follows the renowned biologist Francesca Marucco and other experts on the trail of an Italian nomad wolf on his way to the French Maritime Alps.

programme.title: Wandering Wolves
programme.desc: In Part Two of the documentary, the wolf experts Luigi Boitani, Francesca Marucco, Ilka Reinhardt and Hubert Potocnik track the animals all the way across Europe. We see how wolves often cover over a thousand kilometres on their migrations. They swim through fast-flowing rivers and traverse icy mountain ranges and multi-lane motorways.

programme.title: Casanova - the Art of Seduction
programme.desc: Giacomo Casanova was born in Venice in 1725, to poor parents. Initially, he is expected to become a priest, but he is ultimately going to reject this career path. programme.title: Unsealed: America's Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. Each episode of this series investigates a compelling theory by opening these and other files. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. Just make sure you have your tin foil handy when watching the show.

programme.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
programme.desc: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. programme.title: Woodworkers Guild of America presented by CraftsyTV
programme.sub-title: Crafting Cabinet Doors: Materials & Cutting Techniques
programme.desc: In the episode the craftsman guides viewers through essential techniques and considerations for crafting cabinet doors with precision and efficiency. He begins by stressing the importance of wood selection, advising against woods with prominent grain patterns like oak, which are unsuitable for door frames. Instead, he recommends using straight-grained pieces from the edges of the wood or opting for materials like MDF, birch, or maple for paint-grade projects due to their smooth surfaces and availability in large sheets. The craftsman demonstrates how to prepare materials for construction, including ripping pieces for frames and face frames, and discusses the suitability of poplar for practice due to its affordability and ease of machining. When it comes to door panels, he explains the careful use of plywood and the importance of adjusting grooves precisely for optimal fit. He showcases the use of a dado head to create tenons that snugly fit into these grooves, ensuring strong and gap-free assembly. Techniques for creating specific door styles are highlighted, such as using half-lap joints adjusted on the table saw for flush fits. The craftsman emphasizes marking and consistent cuts to avoid errors, crucial for achieving perfect joints in door frame assembly. He demonstrates assembly steps and discusses adding decorative pegs for both aesthetic appeal and structural integrity, particularly useful for heavier doors like those with leaded glass panels. Throughout the episode, the craftsman underscores the use of templates for ensuring consistent shapes, particularly useful for cathedral-style doors. He employs a band saw and router table with double-sided tape to achieve precision in shaping components, emphasizing careful setup and sequential cuts for optimal woodworking results. Overall, the episode provides comprehensive guidance on wood selection, tool adjustment, joint creation, and assembly techniques, empowering woodworkers to create high-quality cabinet doors effectively.

Then, Audrey Esarey has the guide for sewing curves. Keep stitching under control with some simple tips for curves. Then it's tips for walking foot quilting with Eliane Bergmann in the machine tip.

French Algerian Nordine Mahieddine (27-15, 12 KO) collides with France’s Abderahmane Coulibaly (58-20-1, 25 KO) in a big heavyweight contest, Germany’s Denis Wosik (37-8-1, 9 KO) meets the super popular Albanian Berjan Peposhi (27-3, 16 KO), former GLORY title challenger Karim Ghajji (103-17-1, 53 KO) returns and squares-off against Serbia’s Nikola Todorovic (26-3, 14 KO), and Iliass Hammouche (32-6, 7 KO) will finally make his much anticipated debut against Germany’s Florian Kroger (19-9, 6 KO).

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Bishop Creek Fishing
programme.desc: Growing up in Southern California, there’s a special spot my dad would always take us: the Eastern Sierras. If you love the outdoors, trout fishing, and pure beauty, the Sierras have it all. We especially enjoy venturing up in the fall when the weather changes, the fall colors start popping, and the fishing is phenomenal. The Sierras offer endless options for camping, hiking, and fishing, and that’s exactly what we’re doing for the next couple of weeks. Join us as we explore some creek fishing around Park's Resort, lake fishing at South and Sabrina Lake, and then head into the backcountry for an epic day hike. Don’t miss out on this adventure through one of the most picturesque and diverse regions of California!

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: We present to you historic image and film documents from the Porsche 550 RS Spyder. And: how the Audi Quattro shocked its competitors with its driving dynamics.

programme.title: Classic Ride

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The 1947 Triumph 1800 Roadster provides space for 5 fresh air fans. Also: Le Jog, the toughest classic car rally in Europe. A German women's team takes on the challenge in their VW Iltis. And: a charming oldie, the 1919 Wolseley Stellite.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: With the M3, BMW brought race car technology to the road. In addition: 120 years of Mercedes-Benz motorsports history. And: turbo power in the DTM. The Ford Sierra RS Cosworth taught its racing competition the meaning of fear.

programme.title: Classic Ride

programme.title: Audi Quattro

programme.title: Ford GT40

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The search for the perfect winter car is still on. Patrick Simons puts the Subaru WRX STI and Audi RS6 Clubsport from MTM through their paces. Plus: With the MP4-12C, McLaren brings a successor to their famous F1 model to the streets.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The Volkswagen Jetta is a big seller in the United States. With the sixth generation, Volkswagen wants the model to be successful with European car buyers, too. Plus: we take a look at the new Ford Focus and the BMX X3.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Patrick Simon reviews the Porsche Cayenne S Hybrid. Below its hood is a 333 HP V6 engine and a 47 horsepower electrical motor. Plus: Upcoming racing driver Chris Bauer at the FIA GT1 championship at the Nürburgring.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Test driver Patrick Simon wants to take part in the 24 Hours of Le Mans and reviews his LMPC car. Plus: we compare the Volkswagen Tiguan 2.0 TDI to the Kia Sportage 2.0 CRDI.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Sometimes great things come in small packages like with the Mini John Cooper Works. Also: drifting in the Volkswagen Jetta at the Ice Experience in Sweden. In addition: the Steinbeisser Trophy. And: the Mercedes-AMG CLS 63.

programme.title: Porsche Ruf RT35
programme.desc: Ruf RT35 may look like a Porsche, but it really isn't. Since 1981, the Ruf company in Pfaffhausen, Germany, has been recognized as an independent manufacturer. But the basis for its vehicles comes exclusively from Porsche. A Ruf is even faster and more exclusive than a comparable Porsche.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.sub-title: Chevy Camaro vs Mercedes SLS AMG

programme.title: Bentley Bentayga

programme.title: Mercedes Sprinter, 2018

programme.title: Supercars

programme.title: Supercars
programme.sub-title: Special: 24h of Le Mans - Track Days

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Porsche 911 shows stylistic modesty like no other sports car in the world. It doesn't boast, avoids any loud appearance and puts form over function. We explored the history behind this iconic sports car and the reason why it has been so successful for more than 50 years. In addition: Porsche's Turbo S model, the traditional top model of the brand's 911 production series.

programme.title: Volvo Laplander 6x6

programme.title: Chevrolet Corvair
programme.desc: Despite a production number of nearly 1.4 million units the Chevrolet Corvair is virtually unknown in Europe. It was innovative, efficient, modern and cheap. Nevertheless, it was slandered, torn apart and later reviled.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: The BMW X5M, Audi Q7, Mercedes GLS and Porsche Cayenne Turbo are among the strongest and fastest SUVs in the world. Sports utility vehicles made in Germany are the embodiment of technical perfection, superior performance and unique comfort.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Luxury, lifestyle and exclusivity, no other cars transport these attributes better than the SUVs by Jaguar, Range Rover, Bentley, Volvo and Infinity. These stylish and excellently equipped SUVs embody a spirit of adventure and a zest for life.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: US SUVs and pickup trucks like the Cadillac Escalade, Chevrolet Tahoe, Ford Raptor or Dodge Ram are large, powerful and luxurious and exude the feeling of unlimited possibilities and adventure.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

programme.title: Tuning

programme.title: Tuning

programme.title: Tuning

programme.title: Tuning

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Everyone has a car they fell in love with. Maybe it was the first? Maybe it was the hot rod the guy down the street owned? In Ray’s case, it was the ’58 Chevy he saw in the iconic coming of age car movie, American Graffiti. When Ray gets the chance to own the car after years and years of pursuit, he jumps on it. But restoring the car to its "movie state" proves to be a grueling task that goes way beyond a typical build. But when it's you first love, you can't let her down.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: The premiere episode features a dive into the influence cars had on culture of California. From road racing in the 1940’s to the inception of the iconic Woody wagon on the California beach scene, automobiles undoubtedly shaped the West Coast attitude. Ray talks to The Beach Boys frontman Mike Love and surfing icon Laird Hamilton for a glimpse into the cars that are so connected to surfing culture.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray uncovers the secrets of America’s greatest racing sport in the foothills of North Carolina. When moonshiners were looking to outrun police officers, they would custom fit engines to race the back woods tracks. That sport eventually evolved into NASCAR and Ray talks to the early adopters of this national pastime.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Grammy-winning musician Marty Robbins lived a double life, flawlessly crossing between the glitz of the Grand Ole Opry and track at Talladega. One of few musicians to ever achieve success in both genres, Ray is determined to return Marty’s iconic 777 car to the race track travel back to the 60’s and 70’s.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Legendary drag racer Don “The Snake” Prudhomme proves he is no stranger to the thrill of racing rivalry. Prudhomme’s career and subsequent competition with driver Tom “The Mongoose” McEwan earned the pair an unforgettable imprint on American pop culture. Legions of kids in the 60’s and 70’s flocked to the shelves for Snake and Mongoose Matchbox cars which helped make drag racing an undisputable American pastime. Famed director Ron Howard makes an appearance to discuss the incredible stories hidden within the world of Formula 1 Racing, the topic of his latest, epic feature ‘Rush”.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray finds Buried Treasures in the form of two race cars that had been left almost completely untouched since the last time they were on a race track. programme.desc: A journey to Indianapolis unveils the winning car of the 1955 Indy 500 sits on the roof of an auto mechanic shop. More than 50 years after it’s magic at the track, prominent Indy mechanic/owner Chris Paulsen begins to restore the car and Ray talks about the evolution of America’s illustrious Indy 500.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In the 1960s, Smokey Yunick, the most innovative mechanic in NASCAR history, sold his famous truck that hauled equipment & cars across the country. Ray is on a mission to uncover this storied truck that helped launch the beginning of NASCAR’s cross-country popularity.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray travels to Long Island, New York with the hopes of learning more about America’s first major auto racing competition. The race, which began at the turn of the 20th century, helped develop the first major American racing stars and drove American manufacturing to competitive standard with the highly progressive Europeans.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Fred Dmuchowski is a New Jersey racing icon. He was a regular workingman who raced on weekends for fun and became a legend in his iconic 303 racer. Ray works to rebuild the 303 in homage to Fred who inspired him to pursue his career in motorsports.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: For Rick Hendrick, the Corvette inspired his first car purchase, which ultimately led to the creation of his car dealership empire and motorsports teams. Mr. H, as he goes by, gives us a rare look inside of his personal Corvette collection and takes us to General Motors World Headquarters to talk with GM Vice President of Global Design, Ed Welburn, about how this iconic car came about. Country superstar Brad Paisley makes a cameo appearance to talk about his prized ‘Vette and the influence of cars on his music.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: The last car Elvis drove the evening he passed was his beloved Stutz Blackhawk. Ray discovers that the car has been preserved and heads to Graceland to check out this iconic piece of American music history. Ray and the team reveal the impeccable preservation of the car at Charlotte Motor Speedway with Rick Hendrick (“Mr. H”) and, arguably Elvis Presley’s biggest fan, Dale Earnhardt Jr. While at Graceland, Ray and the team also get an exclusive look at the paneled station wagon Elvis used to get in and out of Graceland in disguise. It’s an intimate look at the King’s incredible automobiles and their secrets that only Elvis knew.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Delta Wing Racer with a Vengeance
programme.desc: State-of-the-art engineering and passion projects take center stage on this edition of Caffeine & Octane. The revolutionary Delta Wing Racer turns on hot lap after hot lap at Road Atlanta, and driver Katherine Legge offers insight on how “less is more” when it comes to power to weight ratios; the dark world of a graffiti artist paints a picture of a car called Vengeance while the hosts share the eclectic hybrids of machines that make it to Caffeine and Octane with Vengance’s creator Totem.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the ultimate scene and the place to be seen. Even after 12 hours of racing at the Petit Le Mans endurance race, Henry Ford III, the great grandson of Henry Ford the industrial magnate and current member of Ford’s Board of Directors, showed up to take in the sights, address the crowds, and sign a one of a kind Ford Shelby GT350R. The GT350R will hit the road with Operation Hope to encourage young people to study math and science through motorsports; Covert car counterfeiter, Chuck Beck looks for Ford’s approval on his own version of a muscled up Festiva. YouTuber ‘That Dude in Blue’ David Patterson joins Skip and Bryan to get a special look at the motor-based philanthropic outreach and amazing cars that come with it done by John Hope Bryant, friend of Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Rickey and Bryan race outside of their comfort zones, each competing to find the raddest car collection. Rickey hangs out with classic racer, Ron Green, who shows him the ropes in the ultra light '83 Ralt RT5. Bryan visits a collection of 120 racing motorcycle owned by mechanic and racer Mike McConville. Mike takes Bryan motorcross racing in his backyard after showing off his high horsepowered car collection. Caffeine and Octane alongside Ron Green visit Atlanta's first Concours d'elegance to look at classic cars that have been perfectly maintained for decades.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: The Wrap on the Most Beautiful Cars
programme.desc: Wayne Phears’ Jaguar E-Type was nothing more than a diamond in the rough before the mineral rights attorney took on the basket case. Caffeine & Octane brings viewers the story of how Phears’, through relentless research and determination, restored and reunited the #10 Jag that Enzo Ferrari called “the most beautiful car ever made”; Atlanta Wraps shows how wrapping Corvettes and Lamborghinis can color a car fast. Caffeine and Exotics is featured again to show off the coolest wraps Atlanta can supply.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Twenty-five years of hand building record-setting race cars is no easy task. But don’t tell that to Don Panoz who takes on Porsches and Ferraris with his laid back personality and a full-production facility that makes improvised versions of Americas V-8’s; Caffeine & Octane gets an exclusive look at an elusive man’s life long pursuit of everything Chevrolet.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane goes old school with Psycho Deville singer and pin striper Walt Richards. Richards has less than a week to hand paint his signature flames on a way cool ’50 Mercury. An introduction to Retrofit Lighting’s trickle down technology - from cars to motorcycles - that will revolutionize how bikes will see and be seen.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Beetles, Bugs, and Buses, Oh My!
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation is tested when over 100 VW’s, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattled into an event. The annual VW Invasion has swarmed C&O, bringing with it Bugs, Beetles, Buses and more by a very dedicated VW fan base.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Rapper, radio, and ATL TV personality Darian “Big Tigger” Morgan invites Caffeine & Octane into his home. Cameras look past his collection of 500 Michael Jordan shoes to focus their lenses on a one-off motorcycle the 6–time NBA Champion gave to Tigger as a gift; A second to none, muscle car collection by one of the founders of Monster Energy gets toured by one of our hosts.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Vintage Testarossas and Quatra Valve Ferraris don’t just show up on a dealer’s floor, they’re hunted! Adam Merlin, exotic car expert, has spent a lifetime searching for the cars that defined his youth, but nothing is assumed or given in his high stakes game of Risk; A muscle car fiend shows off his private collection to host Skip Smith.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the major league of North American car shows. Former Atlanta Brave, World Series star, and 10-Time Gold Glove winner Andruw Jones acknowledged the stardom and showed up to show off his 6 wheeled Super Jeep. The state of the art creation took years in planning and execution, but Jones chooses one great event for its debut.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The natural landscape of Jekyll Island, GA makes for a great backdrop to showcase the country’s greatest cars. But the ocean air and remoteness of this GA barrier island is no place to leave a painstakingly rebuilt ‘59 Imperial Speedster. Host Skip Smith makes it his mission to locate the talented builder behind this island mystery. Guest host Totem joins Bryan Fuller in the C&O lots to pick out his favorites.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane

programme.title: Around the ACL
programme.desc: ATA 204: Vegas Preview, New Engagement Programs, and a Silly Pro Draft This week on Around the ACL, Meesh and Jake are joined by Athena for a packed episode that mixes league insight with some fun. We start with a look at new Player and Director Engagement Programs, where Athena shares what’s being built behind the scenes and how these initiatives aim to strengthen the ACL community at every level. From there, we preview the upcoming Las Vegas Open, breaking down both Singles and Doubles fields and what to watch as players head into another big event weekend. Athena also gives insight into Minor League Teams and what they mean for the league’s development pipeline. To keep things light, the crew wraps up with a Silly ACL Pro Draft, debating which pros you’d trust to plan your wedding, cook dinner, win a trivia night, dominate dodgeball, manage social media, or win a dance-off. As always, we close with bold predictions and quick takes in Hole-y Hot Take. A little news, a little preview, and a lot of personality in this one.

programme.title: Travel with Didiayer

programme.title: Wildest Places
programme.sub-title: Wildest Places S02 E02 - Seasons NB
programme.desc: This episode looks at the various habitats and areas of a coral reef, and how each zone within this extremely complex and delicately balanced ecosystem houses life forms that adapt in unique ways.

programme.title: Wildest Places
programme.sub-title: Wildest Places S02 E03 - Connected Continents
programme.desc: Antarctica was once the centre of the ancient southern supercontinent, Gondwana. Traces of these connections remain throughout the southern hemisphere today: in plants and marine species with similarities that have long-ago changed and adapted to the environment around them.

programme.title: Wildest Places
programme.sub-title: Wildest Places S02 E04 - Icy Islands
programme.desc: When it’s time to haul ashore for breeding, mating and raising young, marine mammals return from the Antarctic Peninsula to island beaches in the middle of the South Atlantic oceans.

programme.title: Departures

programme.desc: A year out, Scott and Justin arrive back on home soil, but can't part ways without one more challenge. An epic adventure which takes them from Vancouver, past the Arctic Circle, to the end of the road, seeing some of the most remote areas in Canada.

programme.title: Health Explored

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S02 E08 - Taste of Life PT 2
programme.desc: Sardinia teaches lessons of community, social connection and good foods - we learn from Dr. Ivo Pirisi what makes this island so special.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.sub-title: Journey Within S01 E01 - Costa Rica
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore Zunya, an eco-village, and its enchanting blue zone concept. We delve into communal living, uncovering its allure. At La Senda, we experience soul cleansing Temazcal and a sublime cacao ceremony. We engage in a farm-to-table activity, savouring locally sourced ingredients. Cala Luna offers a rejuvenating body treatment amidst serene surroundings. We encounter the Maleku Tribes, witnessing their dance ceremony and visiting their cacao farm. The journey concludes with a breath taking hike and a majestic volcano view, reminding us of nature's beauty. This episode is a transformative adventure of self-discovery, cultural immersion, and connection with nature.

programme.title: Journey Within

programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: The Next Turn
programme.desc: Unplanned experiences leave the biggest impact. Watch this episode of The Next Turn, a docu-style travel series, powered by Expedia and Visit Orlando, as it takes host Jo Franco on a journey to embrace adventure to discover the Orlando she never knew. Also an adventure in Azerbaijan, join filmaker Jade Healy as she ventures to the other side of the world to find inspiration in the local tales and colours of Azerbaijan.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: We will travel to Santorini, to build castles of red sand, or black sand, on the beach of Akrotiri. We will see how much fun Santorini offers us, along its mountain range, with its emblematic towns, although hidden on the side of a volcanic mountain, are villages that are full of activity at any time of the day. We will make a stop for tea in Hong Kong and learn about its history. With one of the largest and most iconic horizons in the world, our next destination will make you believe that the past and the present merge in perfect harmony. If you want to try something more traditional of classical Chinese cuisine, enjoy a "Dim sum", a custom similar to British "tea time". "Dim sum" literally means drinking tea. On the last leg of this trip we will explore Mexico City searching for the remains of civilizations that no longer exist The Aztec Empire. Perhaps, we will even find evidence of some that many believe that never existed. According to what is known about them, it was a civilization quite advanced and capable of supporting hundreds of thousands of people.

programme.title: Trails and Trailblazers
programme.sub-title: Zorbing in Gatlinburg, TN & Bourbon Tasting in Louisville
programme.desc: John and Ariel get a taste for rock formations and hot air balloons on their road trip across the “Land of Enchantment”.

programme.title: Dream of Italy
programme.desc: Kathy McCabe invites you to experience the essence of Rome. Discover the Testaccio Market's incredible food, taste true Roman Cacio e Pepe and gelato, learn the beautiful craft of mosaics, and attend a grand ball at Palazzo Brancaccio.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.sub-title: Caprarola and the Duchy of Castro
programme.desc: The duchy of Castro was founded in 1537 by Pope Paul III, Alessandro Farnese, who wanted to donate the area to his son Pier Luigi. The dukedom includes not only Ischia di Castro, the capital city that was destroyed in 1649 by the Papal troops, but also Valentano and Capodimonte where you can still admire the amazing palaces of the Farnese family...

programme.title: Downstream
programme.sub-title: Bardstown, The Beech Fork & The Kentucky Bourbon Festival
programme.desc: Carrie & Kyle adventure to Bardstown, KY for the 25th annual Kentucky Bourbon Festival and a paddle along the Beech Fork River. Featured stories include a country ham and bourbon pairing, a little mint julep history, some crazy grains for making bourbon, a historic Bardstown walking tour and a visit to the spring source for Barton Distillery.

programme.title: Downstream
programme.desc: In this episode Carrie & Kyle take the plunge, literally into Lawrenceburg KY where they explore the Salt River, kayak fishing on Beaver Lake, Lover’s Leap Vineyard, a classic car show downtown and of course Four Roses Bourbon featuring a unique tour with master distiller Brent Elliott.

programme.title: Downstream
programme.desc: “Weave” through the streets of Georgetown to find some ‘royal’ liquid history and learn how one man quenched our thirsts in more ways than one. Featuring: Floating around on the Elkhorn Creek, bourbon blending, Local Feed cuisine and paddling around with a Country Boy who can catch a fish.

programme.title: Downstream
programme.sub-title: Jet Boats, Bourbon Boats, Colonels and Castles
programme.desc: “Kyle & Carrie will have a lot of “balls in the air” when they visit Kentucky’s historic capital city. The hosts will tour Frankfort by boat on the Kentucky River, and on foot stopping in at the Buffalo Trace and Castle & Key distilleries as well as a sweet visit to Rebecca Ruth Candy.

programme.title: Downstream
programme.sub-title: Creeks, Caves & Corvettes and How To Brew Your Own Brew
programme.desc: Kyle & Carrie float thru Bowling Green, KY land of caves and Corvettes where they visit Blue Holler Brew Supplies, Lost River Cave, Travelers Cellar Winery, White Squirrel Brewery and take a paddle on scenic Drake’s Creek.

programme.title: Downstream
programme.sub-title: “Social Fishtancing”, White Water Kayaking & Bourbon Hand Sanitizer
programme.desc: Featuring Hartfield & Co., a Bourbon County distillery in Paris; fishing on Hinkston Creek by the Colville Covered Bridge; kayaking on the Russell Fork River, and sampling homemade apple wine.

programme.title: Downstream
programme.desc: Winchester KY Clark County “Gateway to the Gorge” Downstream Episode 111 What better way to visit Clark County than to fly over the trees into it via a zipline adventure! Kyle and Carrie will visit Wildcat Willy’s Farm to Table and Distillery, Harkness Edwards Vineyard, paddle the Kentucky River with some out of town friends and discover Winchester’s very delectable and edible treasure.

programme.title: Downstream
programme.sub-title: KY Boyle County: Small Town, Big History
programme.desc: Danville Boyle County Kentucky Small Town. Big History Boats, Brass, and Brazilian Rum. Our Boyle County episode will highlight some Of central Kentucky’s little-known treasures including the historic town of Danville and the Dix River which forms Herrington Lake, home to Kentucky’s first reservoir that powers not only the surrounding areas through hydroelectricity, but ignites the hearts of boaters, kayakers, and jet ski enthusiasts. Along the way we’ll hear and see the spectacle that is the Great American Brass Band Festival; visit the Blue Rook Distillery and sample some regional cuisine and a “smoked” Old-Fashioned at Copper and Oak.

programme.title: Downstream
programme.sub-title: Shepherdsville, KY Bullitt County: Wine, Whiskey & Wild Part 1
programme.desc: Shepherdsville Bullitt County Kentucky Wine, Whiskey & Wild The Bullitt County episode will begin at the largest outdoor shooting range followed by a visit to the world-famous Four Roses where we talk all thing’s bourbon with Master Distiller Brent Elliott from the unique flavor profiles to the different tiers of production. Just south of Louisville, we travel to the Bernheim Arboretum, home of the forest giants and the “natural oasis” that recharges and keeps the Bourbon Trail flowing. We continue the adventure at the Forest Edge Winery where we learn about all the fun ways to enjoy wine whether it’s in a can, spicy enough to make you gasp, or made into a soothing slushie. The episode will wrap up at the family run Brooks Hill Winery, from reds to whites there’s a little sip of southern charm. This is the first of a two-part special featuring Shepherdsville and Bullitt County Kentucky.

programme.title: Downstream
programme.sub-title: Shepherdsville, KY Bullitt County: Wine, Whiskey & Wild Part 2
programme.desc: The second part of our Bullitt County visit will begin at the longest g-cart track in the US followed by a visit to the MillaNova and Wight Meyer wineries. Carrie will paddle the Salt River with a special guest who shares some little known history about the river which powered several distilleries and yes, quite a bit of salt. Our hosts will finish up at the famous James B Beam Distillery in Clermont Kentucky where a new restaurant, the Kitchen Table serves up some local fare with a splash of bourbon. This is the second of a two-part special featuring Shepherdsville and Bullitt County Kentucky.

programme.title: Downstream
programme.sub-title: Harrodsburg, KY Mercer County: Celebrating 250 Years of Greatness
programme.desc: Focused in and around Mercer County, KY this historic, history-filled episode kicks off with a special tour of Old Fort Harrod. Liquid stories include Lemons Mill Brewery to sample 24 different brews and a family beer recipe that dates back to prohibition; as well as a sample (or two) of the unique Bum Ditty Hard “still” Cider bottled in downtown Harrodsburg at the Vault. We’ll explore the many acres of Shaker Village of Pleasant Hill, Kentucky’s largest historic landmark. And take a boat ride on Harrington Lake and explore the many aquatic attractions it has to offer, including a jump off Chimney Rock. The episode will wrap up at the charming Beaumont Inn, a former women’s college now the oldest family owned inn in America.

programme.title: Downstream
programme.sub-title: Kentucky Lake / Marshall County Kentucky: A Big Dam Adventure
programme.desc: Located in the western corner of the state, Kentucky Lake is one of the largest man-made lakes in the world. In this episode we learn about the dam that made the lake and the ghost towns that lie beneath it. We’ll visit the Dam Brew Haus and try local beers, learn how to wake surf, play some mini-golf with some unique animals, try local cuisine at Belew’s Dairy Bar and wrap up with a sampling of over 30 beers at the inaugural Old Beach Craft Beer Bash.

programme.title: Follow Alana Australia
programme.desc: Discovering wetlands and pristine beaches, Alana gets up close with the wildest of Aussie flora and fauna, learning about the natural beauty in Australia - and most importantly, how to take care of it.

programme.title: Trails and Trailblazers
programme.desc: John and Ariel check out the rich history of Niagara Falls before discovering the beautiful gorges and lakes the state has to offer.

programme.title: Dream of Italy
programme.desc: In Perugia, we meet two women carrying on their family traditions of handmade stained glass and textiles, and we indulge in Baci candy. In Montefalco, Kathy tours the Tenuta Castelbuono winery, and enjoys a cooking lesson.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: Before crossing the Alps and visiting the Ambras castle, the Imperial Palace, the cathedral and the Tyrolean State Museum, it is important to understand the origins of Tyrol. Beginning in the XII century, in the mountains of Alto Adige. We travel along the Inn and the Adige rivers to the entrance of the Vinschgau Valley, before visiting Tyrol Castle, and the city of Merano.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Phillip enters the Singapore outlet of celebrity Chef Joël Robuchon’s French restaurant, voted number 4 on the San Pellegrino Asia’s 50 Best Restaurants list in 2013 and meets Chef de Cuisine, Lorenz Hoja to explore their unique dining concept.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 95: Sospechas, Celos y Secretos Familiares Revelados
programme.desc: Dileidi trata de despedirse de Lu s Fernando con un beso en la mejilla pero el no se resiste y voltea un poco la cara para que sea en la boca; Dileidi le reclama. En casa de Gladis, Gabito la invita a salir, pero Gladis se niega, Dileidi llega a la casa y Aureliano le asoma un peque o reclamo pero Dileidi tambi n se molesta y le recuerda que ellos son amigos. Gladis le pregunta qui n la llevo hasta la casa y Dileidi miente. Por otro lado Santiago flirtrea con Egle en su casa y llega Lu s Fernando y los encuentra muy contento preguntando cual es el chiste; ellos disimulan pero los interrumpe Mar a Gracia d ndole la bienvenida a Lu s Fernando y llev ndoselo para el cuarto. Jerson que se encuentra en la cocina con Gladis, le comenta que se siente muy bien por el trabajo de vigilante que ahora tiene, y le comenta que le gustar a que su pap lo viera porque puede sentirse orgulloso de el vi ndolo vestido de uniforme; Gladis se enoja por ese comentario porque Jerson sabe que su pap los abandono cuando supo que ella estaba embarazada. Jerson insiste y le pregunta si sabe en donde localizarlo, Gladis lo niega. Aristigueta se encuentra reunido con Marco Aurelio discutiendo el proyecto de la urbanizaci n y son interrumpidos por una llamada que le hicieron a Aristigueta sobre el pedido de flores. Marco Aurelio se asombra por la hora de ese pedido pero Aristigueta le responde que es el amor. La Nena est muy nerviosa porque no sabe quien est tocando el timbre porque puede ser Aristigueta o Doroteo. Cuando abre se da cuenta que es Doroteo y lo recibe muy bien. La Nena nota que Doroteo est extra o y este le reclama sobre el supuesto mercadito que le regalaron las amigas, porque Jerson le cont a Doroteo que ese mercadito se lo llevaron en un carrazo y un chofer hasta su casa, y el lo nico que quiere saber si es verdad que ella tiene una conquista millonaria. La Nena se muestra molesta por ese reclamo y porque la esta tildando de mentirosa y discuten, pero en ese momento el timbre suena y es una persona que por cierto le pide ayuda a Doroteo para poder llevar a la casa muchos ramos de flores. Cuando el mensajero se va de la casa Doroteo le reclama por todas flores y se va muy molesto de la casa. La Nena trata de detenerlo pero sin xito. Tatiana llega en ese momento y se muestra muy alegre por todos esos ramos. Gabito y Aureliano llegan a la bodega muy mal por el rechazo que obtuvieron tanto de Gladis como de Dileidi respectivamente; All son recibidos por Remedio con una gran comida y mucho cari o. Dileidi que esta con Yeniluz en su cuarto le propone que trabaje con ella en la empresa, y le cuenta adem s que qui n la llevo para su casa fue Lu s Fernando. Mientras que en casa de Egle, Lu s Fernando le est contando todo lo que le pasa con Dileidi, pero Santiago no le esta poniendo atenci n alguna, ya que lo que est pendiente es de Egle que est en el sofa y viceversa, Egle hace que est leyendo pero lo que est es pendiente de Santiago. Egle se despide porque supuestamente se va a dormir y Santiago tambi n lo hace muy apresuradamente dejando a Lu s Fernando sin poder contar todo lo sucedido. R mulo dormido sue a con varias escena y en todas ellas aparecen dici ndolo que no lo saben o puede ser. R mulo se despierta exaltado y piensa que todo est clarisimo; Egle lo traicion , se esta acostando con otro y par ndose y llegando a la casa de Egle despertando a todos. R mulo le reclama a Egle y ella est muy confusa porque no sabe de lo que le est hablando el. R mulo sigue habl ndole y le dice pregunta en que momento lo dejo de querer para traicionarlo as . Betzaida se da cuenta que R mulo no est a su lado y llama a su mam y le comenta, su mam trata de justificarlo. Cuando R mulo llega a su casa, se pone a llorar y lo que no sabe es que Betzaida esta escondida observ ndolo. Gladis llega a casa de la Nena y esta le cuenta todo lo que le paso con Doroteo y con Aristigueta. Jerson al ver a Tatianita la piropea y lo que no saben los dos, es que son hijos del mismo padre. Doroteo que esta desayunando con Aristigueta le cuenta lo que le est pasando con la Nena, sin saber que esa conquista que tiene es el mismo Aristigueta. Dileidi lleva a Yeniluz al trabajo y obtiene el puesto de recepcionista. Matilde al llegar al trabajo con Gonzalo se da cuenta de la forma en cambia de personalidad. Matilde le avisa a Monchito que deben estar con cautela porque Gonzalo sospecha de el. En el estacionamiento del edificio la Nena, Tatianita y Pascuita est n conversando sobre los esfuerzo que est realizando Pascuita por quedar embarazada y estas le dan cierto consejos. Tatiana convence a La Nena para que le preste el carro que le acaba de regalar Aristigueta. La Nena no se lo quiere prestar porque ella no quiere recibir ese auto pero es convencida por Tatianita y se lo presta. Doroteo esta en la parte de abajo del edificio porque le va a pedir perd n porque cree que La Nena est ofendida, pero ve salir a Tatiana con el carro nuevo, que supuestamente La Nena le dijo que era de la vecina corroborando as la mentira y la conquista millonaria que tiene ella.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 40: Doble compromiso, celos y burla.
programme.desc: Luis Guillermo llega a la casa de los Malav justo despu s que Walter hizo la petici n de mano de Daniela y Armando se burla de l y todos se asombran cuando a continuaci n llega In s invitada por Robert quien anuncia tambi n su compromiso con ella. Michelle se molesta cuando Diego Andr s se niega a mostrar el medall n a Flavia y Marisela oye cuando ste dice que lo entreg a las autoridades para saber que no fue robado. Daniela le reclama a Robert por haber llevado a In s a la casa y ste no le hace caso. Armando con sus comentarios trata de molestar a In s pero ella le hace ver que aceptar que Robert se retraiga de su petici n de matrimonio si as lo desea y Berta se burla de todos los presentes.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, Mar a Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandon a las dos mucho tiempo atr s para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de Mar a Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que tambi n tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relaci n extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. Mar a Antonieta fallece despu s de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Es el entierro de Salvatore. Inmaculada ve a Salom n en el funeral y se desmaya. Inmaculada le cuenta a Abril esto, y ella le dice que es imposible, porque Salom n Grun, est preso. Sof a enfrenta a su padre Vespasiano y no puede creer que haya sido capaz de hacerle tanto da o a Pelusa. Sof a est dolida triste y decepcionada. Para ella su padre, era un hombre perfecto, honesto, sincero, y no puede creer, que result ser un pat n, un sinverg enza y un mujeriego. Sof a le dice a Vespasiano, que Josu jam s va a perdonarle lo que hizo, porque Josu , fue quien sac a Pelusa de la condena en la que l la meti , s lo para salvar su reputaci n. Sof a le dice que ella no le va a decir nada a Josu .

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 52: El ruego de B rbara y el secreto de Charo
programme.desc: B rbara busca a Manuel en el club de box, le jura que l es el hombre que ella ama, que nunca pas nada con Tommy y que el dinero y los autos lujosos ya no son importantes para ella, pues lo nico que quiere es que l la perdone, sin embargo Manuel sigue muy dolido y no la perdona. - Mientras Josefina le dice a Sebasti n que no cree nada de lo que le dijo Sara sobre la locura de Clara, vemos a Charo algo desquiciada mentalmente, vestida y peinada como Socorro y hablando ante un espejo como si se tratara de la propia Coc . Isabel presencia este cuadro y Charo la amenaza con decirle a Socorro que el padre del hijo que espera es Julio C sar si le cuenta a su amiga algo de lo que acab de ver.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 52: Abuso de poder y silencio forzado
programme.desc: Marisela es victima del abuso de poder de Nancy tras intentar interrogar a Gabriela en cuanto a su relaci n con Ricardo. Gabriela en vista de la falta de comunicaci n confunde la situaci n de Marisela con un gesto de antipat a. Gabriela se deja sorprender por el regreso de Fernando a su casa. Abril sinti ndose interesada en indagar mas acerca de la vida de Gavil n intenta obtener informaci n por medio del muchacho quien se muestra renuente al sentirse supuestamente acosado por ella. Marisela se ve obligada a mantener silencio ante los maltratos y las ofensas de Nancy esperando as mantener su trabajo dentro de la cl nica a pesar de ser degradada

programme.desc: Dileidi trata de despedirse de Lu s Fernando con un beso en la mejilla pero el no se resiste y voltea un poco la cara para que sea en la boca; Dileidi le reclama. En casa de Gladis, Gabito la invita a salir, pero Gladis se niega, Dileidi llega a la casa y Aureliano le asoma un peque o reclamo pero Dileidi tambi n se molesta y le recuerda que ellos son amigos. Gladis le pregunta qui n la llevo hasta la casa y Dileidi miente. Por otro lado Santiago flirtrea con Egle en su casa y llega Lu s Fernando y los encuentra muy contento preguntando cual es el chiste; ellos disimulan pero los interrumpe Mar a Gracia d ndole la bienvenida a Lu s Fernando y llev ndoselo para el cuarto. Jerson que se encuentra en la cocina con Gladis, le comenta que se siente muy bien por el trabajo de vigilante que ahora tiene, y le comenta que le gustar a que su pap lo viera porque puede sentirse orgulloso de el vi ndolo vestido de uniforme; Gladis se enoja por ese comentario porque Jerson sabe que su pap los abandono cuando supo que ella estaba embarazada. Jerson insiste y le pregunta si sabe en donde localizarlo, Gladis lo niega. Aristigueta se encuentra reunido con Marco Aurelio discutiendo el proyecto de la urbanizaci n y son interrumpidos por una llamada que le hicieron a Aristigueta sobre el pedido de flores. Marco Aurelio se asombra por la hora de ese pedido pero Aristigueta le responde que es el amor. La Nena est muy nerviosa porque no sabe quien est tocando el timbre porque puede ser Aristigueta o Doroteo. Cuando abre se da cuenta que es Doroteo y lo recibe muy bien. La Nena nota que Doroteo est extra o y este le reclama sobre el supuesto mercadito que le regalaron las amigas, porque Jerson le cont a Doroteo que ese mercadito se lo llevaron en un carrazo y un chofer hasta su casa, y el lo nico que quiere saber si es verdad que ella tiene una conquista millonaria. La Nena se muestra molesta por ese reclamo y porque la esta tildando de mentirosa y discuten, pero en ese momento el timbre suena y es una persona que por cierto le pide ayuda a Doroteo para poder llevar a la casa muchos ramos de flores. Cuando el mensajero se va de la casa Doroteo le reclama por todas flores y se va muy molesto de la casa. La Nena trata de detenerlo pero sin xito. Tatiana llega en ese momento y se muestra muy alegre por todos esos ramos. Gabito y Aureliano llegan a la bodega muy mal por el rechazo que obtuvieron tanto de Gladis como de Dileidi respectivamente; All son recibidos por Remedio con una gran comida y mucho cari o. Dileidi que esta con Yeniluz en su cuarto le propone que trabaje con ella en la empresa, y le cuenta adem s que qui n la llevo para su casa fue Lu s Fernando. Mientras que en casa de Egle, Lu s Fernando le est contando todo lo que le pasa con Dileidi, pero Santiago no le esta poniendo atenci n alguna, ya que lo que est pendiente es de Egle que est en el sofa y viceversa, Egle hace que est leyendo pero lo que est es pendiente de Santiago. Egle se despide porque supuestamente se va a dormir y Santiago tambi n lo hace muy apresuradamente dejando a Lu s Fernando sin poder contar todo lo sucedido. R mulo dormido sue a con varias escena y en todas ellas aparecen dici ndolo que no lo saben o puede ser. R mulo se despierta exaltado y piensa que todo est clarisimo; Egle lo traicion , se esta acostando con otro y par ndose y llegando a la casa de Egle despertando a todos. R mulo le reclama a Egle y ella est muy confusa porque no sabe de lo que le est hablando el. R mulo sigue habl ndole y le dice pregunta en que momento lo dejo de querer para traicionarlo as . Betzaida se da cuenta que R mulo no est a su lado y llama a su mam y le comenta, su mam trata de justificarlo. Cuando R mulo llega a su casa, se pone a llorar y lo que no sabe es que Betzaida esta escondida observ ndolo. Gladis llega a casa de la Nena y esta le cuenta todo lo que le paso con Doroteo y con Aristigueta. Jerson al ver a Tatianita la piropea y lo que no saben los dos, es que son hijos del mismo padre. Doroteo que esta desayunando con Aristigueta le cuenta lo que le est pasando con la Nena, sin saber que esa conquista que tiene es el mismo Aristigueta. Dileidi lleva a Yeniluz al trabajo y obtiene el puesto de recepcionista. Matilde al llegar al trabajo con Gonzalo se da cuenta de la forma en cambia de personalidad. Matilde le avisa a Monchito que deben estar con cautela porque Gonzalo sospecha de el. En el estacionamiento del edificio la Nena, Tatianita y Pascuita est n conversando sobre los esfuerzo que est realizando Pascuita por quedar embarazada y estas le dan cierto consejos. Tatiana convence a La Nena para que le preste el carro que le acaba de regalar Aristigueta. La Nena no se lo quiere prestar porque ella no quiere recibir ese auto pero es convencida por Tatianita y se lo presta. Doroteo esta en la parte de abajo del edificio porque le va a pedir perd n porque cree que La Nena est ofendida, pero ve salir a Tatiana con el carro nuevo, que supuestamente La Nena le dijo que era de la vecina corroborando as la mentira y la conquista millonaria que tiene ella.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, Mar a Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandon a las dos mucho tiempo atr s para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de Mar a Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que tambi n tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relaci n extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. Mar a Antonieta fallece despu s de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Es el entierro de Salvatore. Inmaculada ve a Salom n en el funeral y se desmaya. Inmaculada le cuenta a Abril esto, y ella le dice que es imposible, porque Salom n Grun, est preso. Sof a enfrenta a su padre Vespasiano y no puede creer que haya sido capaz de hacerle tanto da o a Pelusa. Sof a est dolida triste y decepcionada. Para ella su padre, era un hombre perfecto, honesto, sincero, y no puede creer, que result ser un pat n, un sinverg enza y un mujeriego. Sof a le dice a Vespasiano, que Josu jam s va a perdonarle lo que hizo, porque Josu , fue quien sac a Pelusa de la condena en la que l la meti , s lo para salvar su reputaci n. Sof a le dice que ella no le va a decir nada a Josu .
